Check the Dashboard: Look for a “Pending” status under the transaction or redemption history. Sometimes a “Cancel” button appears next to the request on the user end.

Contact Support Immediately: If no cancel button is present, the fastest way to stop the transaction is usually to contact customer support directly. Request them to void the request before it moves to the payout stage. Mention that you want to cancel it and convert the funds back to your playable balance (if applicable).

Understand the Cut-off Time: Many platforms allow cancellations only before the review team “locks” the transaction for processing. Once it moves to “Approved” or “Processing,” it likely cannot be stopped.

Re-purchase vs. Reversal: If the redemption cannot be cancelled, you might need to wait for the funds to arrive in your bank account and then use them to make a new purchase or deposit.

Final Recommendation: If you need to cancel a pending redemption, contact your platform’s customer service right away, as policies vary and timing is critical.

[08:44:03 PM] Diana Lopez: Hello
[08:44:39 PM] Diana Lopez: Here is how you can check if a cancellation is possible:

Check the Dashboard: Look for a “Pending” status under the transaction or redemption history. Sometimes a “Cancel” button appears next to the request on the user end.

Contact Support Immediately: If no cancel button is present, the fastest way to stop the transaction is usually to contact customer support directly. Request them to void the request before it moves to the payout stage. Mention that you want to cancel it and convert the funds back to your playable balance (if applicable).

Understand the Cut-off Time: Many platforms allow cancellations only before the review team “locks” the transaction for processing. Once it moves to “Approved” or “Processing,” it likely cannot be stopped.

Re-purchase vs. Reversal: If the redemption cannot be cancelled, you might need to wait for the funds to arrive in your bank account and then use them to make a new purchase or deposit.

Final Recommendation: If you need to cancel a pending redemption, contact your platform’s customer service right away, as policies vary and timing is critical.
